brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Tidy storage for sewing supplies (small items separated, easy to see)
requirements.evidence: 4 cells with bins: 0,-1 has div3 for small notions, -1,0 / 0,0 / 1,-1 have full bins for larger items; props show separation - solder-reel as thread spool in bin:-1,0,0, tape-gaffer in bin:1,-1,0, tweezers in bin:0,0,0, pen in bin:0,-1,0 compartment

requirements.requirement: Representation of thread/spools, fabric, scissors etc
requirements.evidence: Catalog has no sewing-specific props; used workshop props as proxies: solder-reel = thread spool, tape-gaffer = fabric roll/tape, tweezers/scissors proxy, pen/marker; bins provide correct compartmentalization even if exact sewing props unavailable

finish.summary: Linear 3-cell cluster with a forward work cell, four bins providing divided and open storage for sewing notions; staged with available props as proxies for thread spools and tools.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
